text: Temporary well abandonment operations proposed in APM approved September 22, 2011 were unsuccessful at this time.  Modifications to wellbore include setting of CIBP in SS tubing @ 8880' and setting of storm plugs in dual string tubing @ 346' (LS) and 990' (SS).  All wellbore modifications are indicated on attached wellbore schematic.

Wellbore drilled to total depth of 8675-ft MD, 8321-ft TVD with 16.3 ppg mud. A 5 1/2-inch production liner was run to TD with TOL at 7689-ft. Initial completion operations were performed with a mudline tree. Wellbore completed as a single, GP gas completion in the BN 8400-ft Sand with perforations from 8400-8430-ft and 8439-8453-ft MD.

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 06/16/2025.

Permanently abandon A003 by jetting a hole, cutting all casings at 16' BML, and installing a well head cap in the 30" drive pipe. Squeeze micro-matrix cement into micro annuli to stop bubbles. Confirmed no bubbles present 2/18/2013.

WELL IS DSI. NO HYDROCARBONS WERE ENCOUNTERED WHILE DRILLING TO SURFACE CASING SETTING DEPTH. WELL GA019 PBHL IS IN AC 0813 ON LEASE G17561, SURF LOC'N IS IN AC 0857 ON LEASE G17565. Batch set location is in surface location.

Well is currently in TA status. The 2-7/8" tubing, 7" and 9-5/8" casings have been cut and pulled. The 13-3/8" casing and 26" drive pipe are cut at 4" AML and will be cut at minimum of 15' BML and recovered at platform abandonment.

Diagnostics were performed to confirm the integrity of the surface plug set on 1/2/14. Please note a dryhole tree w/gauge was installed 4/18/15 and the will be monitored for pressure for the next 4 months; per BSEE's request. Records will be submitted to BSEE at the end of the 4 months under separate APM.

Well Status & Wellbore remain the same.

Operations to temporarily abandon this well thru the surface plug were completed on 09/19/2017.  Please note, the well was given a status of "temporarily abandoned" on 10/01/2005 & the status date remains the same.

Due to the fact that this well was considered TA'd by a previous operator, McMoRan is not aware of all the dates the cement plugs were placed.  McMoRan PA'd (all casings cut and pulled @ 20-ft BML) the well on 08/22/2012.

HYDRO PLUGGED AND TEMPORARILY ABANDONED THE G 15781 A001 ST00BP01 WELL BORE. THE 9-5/8", 13-3/8" & 18-5/8" CASINGS & 36" DRIVE PIPE ARE CEMENTED TOGETHER. THEY WILL BE CUT & REMOVED FROM A MINIMUM OF 15' BML WHEN THE PLATFORM IS REMOVED.

Operations were successfully completed on the SS Block 112 Well V-5(ST01) to isolate the "R-15" Sand completion existing perforations of 10,728'-10,734' & 10,775'-10,794' MD by setting a TTBP at 10,697' MD and dumping 52' of cement on top of the plug; ETOC at 10,645' MD. The TTBP at 10,697' and cement plug at 10,645' MD were pressure tested to 1000 psi. Subsequent zone change operations were suspended due to tubing x casing communication found and the "R-13" Sand was not perforated for production. Operations began 10/18/2012 and ended 10/22/2012.

MI SL, RU lubricator & tested to 250/3000 psi.  RIH w/tubing punch charges & punched tubing @ 2133' - 2141'.  RD & MOL.  Turned well to production.  Well Test 12/2/05 - 2460 MCFD, 0 BOPD, 792 BWPD, 530 psi FTP on a 128 choke.

Remington has performed completion operations of the EC 282 #C-1 wellbore as a single frac-pack completion in the Cris S-4 SD w/perforations F/13658' - 13696' MD / 13498' - 13532' TVD & 13734' - 13752' MD / 13567' - 13583' TVD.

The WC 176 OCS-00762, Well No. 14 wellbore was spud on June 02, 2007 and TD'd on June 15, 2007 at a depth of 10780'MD / 10603' TVD.  POOH after TD,  and parts of the drill bit were left in the hole.  The decision was made to plugback the wellbore for sidetrack operations.  The wellbore was plugged back and sidetracked on June 18, 2007.

Well was batch set (through the 22" casing) and suspended on 05/02/2012, pending further operations.
On 05/31/2012, tagged cement @ 8,697'. Apply 20k weight test down. Displaced well to 12.2 ppg mud with corrosion inhibitor. Install 30" TA Cap and inject McDermid fluid in TA Cap.

Stone performed zone change operations on the PL 23, OCS-G-01238, Well C4ST1BP1 to produce the "CP 28" Sand.  Operations began on August 18, 2008, and were completed on September 30, 2008. The previous producing interval, the "CP 29" Sand was isolated by setting a posi-set plug @ 15310' MD and dumping 25' cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15285'.  

The "CP 28" Sand was exposed to production by perforating from 15180' - 15192' MD.  The well was turned over to production on October 1, 2008; however, the "CP 28" watered out and did not produce at economic levels.  Test results for October 2, 2008:  38 MCFPD, 0 BCPD, 1600 BWPD.  A Notice of 1st Production is not being filed for the "CP 28" Sand completion interval.  The well is shut-in while waiting for zone change operations to be completed to produce the "CP24" Sand.

BASED ON RESIDUE ON THE TOOLSTRING, IT APPEARS THE RESTRICTION IS A COMBINATION OF ASPHLTENE AND PARAFFIN. THERREFORE THE APPROVED SLEEVE SHIFT AND DOWNHOLE COMMINGLING COULD NOT BE CONDUCTED.(AS APPROVED 6/25/13.)
